instructions:
Sales Mama catalog (A2UI v0.9). Build report surfaces for a B2B sales team.
Rules: (1) Numbers come from scripts: bind every data prop to the block's dataRef file with {"path": "/…"}; never type a number into a chart, tile or table. (2) Lead with one Callout of judgement, then KPIs, then charts, then tables. (3) Pick the chart for the question: trend → LineChart, ranking → BarChart horizontal, share → DonutChart (≤7 slices), conversion → Funnel, matrix → Heatmap, progress → Gauge. (4) Use basic ChoicePicker/Tabs for filters; they change the local data model only. (5) ActionBar and card actions prompt a skill or a plain request; never "send" (ADR-0007). (6) Operational results (plan, agents, draft, reply, account, brief, review queue, run status, error) use the *Card components: one per surface root, or several in a Column.

formatString.description: Performs string interpolation of data model values and other functions in the catalog functions list and returns the resulting string. The value string can contain interpolated expressions in the `${expression}` format. Supported expression types include: JSON Pointer paths to the data model (e.g., `${/absolute/path}` or `${relative/path}`), and client-side function calls (e.g., `${now()}`). Function arguments must be named (e.g., `${formatDate(value:${/currentDate}, format:'MM-dd')}`). To include a literal `${` sequence, escape it as `\${`.

formatNumber.description: Formats a number with the specified grouping and decimal precision.

decimals.description: Optional. The number of decimal places to show. Defaults to 0 or 2 depending on locale.

grouping.description: Optional. If true, uses locale-specific grouping separators (e.g. '1,000'). If false, returns raw digits (e.g. '1000'). Defaults to true.

formatCurrency.description: Formats a number as a currency string.

decimals.description: Optional. The number of decimal places to show. Defaults to 0 or 2 depending on locale.

grouping.description: Optional. If true, uses locale-specific grouping separators (e.g. '1,000'). If false, returns raw digits (e.g. '1000'). Defaults to true.

formatDate.description: Formats a timestamp into a string using a pattern.

format.description:
A Unicode TR35 date pattern string.

Token Reference:
- Year: 'yy' (26), 'yyyy' (2026)
- Month: 'M' (1), 'MM' (01), 'MMM' (Jan), 'MMMM' (January)
- Day: 'd' (1), 'dd' (01), 'E' (Tue), 'EEEE' (Tuesday)
- Hour (12h): 'h' (1-12), 'hh' (01-12) - requires 'a' for AM/PM
- Hour (24h): 'H' (0-23), 'HH' (00-23) - Military Time
- Minute: 'mm' (00-59)
- Second: 'ss' (00-59)
- Period: 'a' (AM/PM)

Examples:
- 'MMM dd, yyyy' -> 'Jan 16, 2026'
- 'HH:mm' -> '14:30' (Military)
- 'h:mm a' -> '2:30 PM'
- 'EEEE, d MMMM' -> 'Friday, 16 January'

pluralize.description: Returns a localized string based on the Common Locale Data Repository (CLDR) plural category of the count (zero, one, two, few, many, other). Requires an 'other' fallback. For English, just use 'one' and 'other'.

value.description: The numeric value used to determine the plural category.

two.description: String for the 'two' category (used in Arabic, Welsh, etc.).

few.description: String for the 'few' category (e.g., small groups in Slavic languages).

many.description: String for the 'many' category (e.g., large groups in various languages).

other.description: The default/fallback string (used for general plural cases).

title: Sales Mama A2UI catalog

docs.Panel: A titled card. Children stack inside. span "full" takes the whole row in a Grid.
docs.Grid: Responsive grid of children (Panels, tiles). min = smallest column width in px (default 320).
docs.Callout: One or two sentences of judgement (markdown). tone colours the bar. Never put numbers here that are not in the data.
docs.KpiTile: A single number with label, unit, optional delta and sparkline. Bind value/delta/spark to data.
docs.StatGrid: Tiles from a data array of {label, value, unit?, note?, status?}, e.g. a metrics section items.
docs.BarChart: Bars from an array of objects (or a {key: number} map). x = category key (default "label"), y = one or more value keys (default "value"). orientation horizontal for long labels; stacked for parts of a whole.
docs.LineChart: Trend over an ordered x (weeks, dates). y = one or more keys. area fills under the line.
docs.DonutChart: Share of a whole, 2–7 slices. data = array of {label, value} or a {key: number} map.
docs.Funnel: Stage conversion (new → researched → contacted → replied → meeting). data = {stage: count} map, {stage: {now, week_ago}} map or [{label, value}]. compareKey reads an earlier value from each row (e.g. "week_ago"); compare = a separate earlier snapshot.
docs.Heatmap: Matrix of numbers: rows = data array, row label from rowKey, one column per key in columns. Good for rep × tier or rep × industry.
docs.Gauge: Progress to a limit or target (capacity, quota, meetings vs target).
docs.ScoreBreakdown: Lead score as weighted parts. parts = {fit, intent, propensity, engagement} (0–1), weights = same keys.
docs.DataTable: Sortable, filterable table (max 25 rows visible, the rest behind "show all"). format "account" opens the wiki page, "source" opens a file, "status"/"tier" draw badges.
docs.CheckList: Rule results. checks = [{id, check, result: pass|warn|fail|unknown|n/a|info, detail}] or groups = [{name, checks}].
docs.CompareTable: Side-by-side companies: companies = [{name, verdict, score}], rows = [{check, values: [{result, text}]}].
docs.SourceChips: Buttons that open repo files read-only (wiki/, log/, raw/, knowledge/, company-check/reports/).
docs.ActionBar: Up to 4 buttons; each sends its prompt as the next turn. Never a send action (ADR-0007).
docs.PlanCard: Steps of a multi-step skill. steps = [{label, status: pending|running|done|failed, agent?, note?}].
docs.AgentsCard: Subagent lanes. lanes = [{agent, label, done, total, status}].
docs.DaySummaryCard: The rep's morning: drafts ready, send window, hot accounts, at-risk count, what needs the rep.
docs.DraftCard: One saved draft; passed = the draft_check.py checks it passed (the card shows them as checks). Never a send action: sending is /mama-send in chat (ADR-0007).
docs.ReplyCard: One triaged inbound reply and its class.
docs.AccountCard: An account: tier, score and parts, stage, cited signals, recommendation chain, next action.
docs.BriefCard: A call or event brief. sections = [{heading, bullets[]}].
docs.ReviewQueueCard: Entity matches for the manager. items = [{n, text, source, candidate, confidence}].
docs.RunStatusCard: A scan or nightly run: ok, times, markets, counts, errors.
docs.ErrorCard: Something blocked the skill: message and the fix.
